review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-019 specifies that upon transitioning to Combat mode, the SFMC software shall automatically activate the defensive shields. The requirement clearly states the trigger (entering Combat mode, defined in §1.3) and the required SFMC action (activating defensive shields, detailed as a subsystem interface in §2.5). The sentence contains clear, verifiable mandatory software behavior without vague language, escape clauses, ambiguous allocation, or undefined categories. Thus, the software requirement status is YES, and the quality status is ACCEPTABLE.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-019 clearly requires the SFMC to activate defensive shields when entering Combat mode, establishing an unambiguous and verifiable operational behavior without writing defects.
